controlled_provider_evidence.scope: Cloudflare control plane and controlled OVH deployment, verified through authenticated control-plane readback or visible dashboard state.
controlled_provider_evidence.record_handling: Provider identifiers, DNS rollback snapshot identifiers, credentials, browser session data and host addresses remain outside the repository in controlled operational access. No value is copied into this evidence.
controlled_provider_evidence.diagnostic_not_used_for_acceptance: A short-lived service-token UI probe still returned 302 after an 18-second propagation wait. Its policy and token were removed sequentially and verified absent. This non-interactive diagnostic does not replace the explicit unauthenticated-UI Access assertion and is not counted as a PASS.

residual_risk_and_non_claims: SA-505 is accepted, but SA-506 and SA-507 have not started and must each satisfy their own blocking assertions before any Git commit or GitHub push.

No real end-user interactive Cloudflare Access session was exercised in this run; the accepted UI requirement is the real unauthenticated Access block, while the Core Host/header fail-closed behavior is independently tested.
No XHS, Douyin, Kuaishou, Bilibili, Reddit, X, Instagram, Notion, GitHub destination, Private-Database, R2 or OCI production provider canary is implied by this deployment acceptance.
The public status projection deliberately reports degraded until real connector/destination authorization is completed; it exposes only the documented sanitized schema.
No credentials, host addresses, Access/Tunnel/DNS/Rule identifiers, cookies, user content or runtime database material are present in this repository evidence.
